RBANM’s Pre-University College was established by RBANM’s Educational Charities in the year 1971 to cater to the educational needs of the fast growing modern and tech city of Bangalore. This is one of the institutions established under the umbrella of the RBANM’s Educational Charities founded 148 years ago in 1873 by Dharmarathnakara Rai Bahadur Arcot Narrainswamy Mudaliar. Our founder embarked on his vision of social regeneration, providing for all classes and castes in the fields of education, social welfare and religion. The institution is the fulfilment of the vision of its founder. In the three decades of service RBANM’s Pre-University College has made significant progression in education.

Our College was started in the year 1971 consequent to the introduction of the two-year course in the Pre-University Education and the establishment of the Junior college in Karnataka State. XI standard of the Higher Secondary School was separated and formed into R.B.A.N.M s Junior College in June 1971 with the permission of the Government of Karnataka, vide their order No. ED71 Pre –University dated 24.03.1972. The first batch of students appeared for the II PU Board Exam in 1973.

A student’s achievement is largely due to the culture at home. Respect, humility, honesty, sincerity, loyalty and citizenship to your institution, family and country is fundamental. Student’s pride for their Institution is highly correlated to their attitude towards their teachers.

At RBANM’s Institution we strongly believe that all children are born equal. We also believe that each one is blessed with a special talent. Your attitudes and habits, the home and institution environments combine in unique ways to shape your personality and enable you to realize your full potential. Parents, the institution and you will have to work in harmony to make you the best that you can become

Our institution is ranked amongst the best in Bangalore and is graded „A by the department of PUE. It is well known for academics, sports and N.C.C. Our campus is in the heart of the city close to Ulsoor Lake. We have spacious classrooms, corridors, greenery and enough space for daily assembly.

The RBANM’s Institution are run by RBANM’s Educational Charities. The goal of the Charities is to provide value based education to the poorer sections of society that enables them to realize their true potential.

Sri Narrainsawmy Mudaliar was born on May 14, 1827 in Arcot, which belonged to the Madras Presidency. Sri Narrainsawmy Mudaliar’s early years were full of struggle and trial. He lost his father at an early age and had shouldered the responsibility of a large family.
He did not have the opportunity to study English language, so he studied and acquired a deep knowledge of ancient sacred Tamil literature which helped in moulding his character.

Soon after his marriage when he shifted to Bengaluru, he started vegetable and salt business. His hard work and perseverance paid off and later he started a furniture shop in the year 1852. Although he led a simple life he was known as a charitable man who always helped the poor. The Delhi Assembly of royals recognized his service to the poor and honored him with a title “Rai Bahadur”.

Sri Narrainsawmy Mudaliar expanded his business and took up construction contracts. He bagged a partnership contract for the construction of Attarakacheri (eighteen offices). Presently the High Court is housed in that building. This was his major achievement and this earned him a large fortune and the sobriquet “Merchant prince of Bengaluru”. His services were duly acknowledged by the Maharaja of Mysore who gifted him 400 acres of land in Bengaluru and Mysore, all of which was later lost in land reform laws.

Though he himself was not educated, he knew the value of education so he started a charitable institution for poor Hindu boys. He started two Thirukulathar institution for the Dalith, one in cantonment and another in Ulsoor way back in 1875.

He also realized the importance of education for girls in those days and started a girl’s institution in 1886 in Ulsoor, named after his wife Smt. Govindammal. He also started a technical institution with surveying, drawing, and other commercial subjects which faded away after engineering colleges came into existence in 1923.

His furniture shop flourished around the same time and earned the honor of Maharaja Sri Chamarajendra Wodeyar’s visit in 1892 and since then the shop was known to people as “Mysore Maharaja Hall”. Sri. Narrainsawmy Mudaliar was honored with the title “Dharmaratnakara‟ in 1894. Sri. Narrainsawmy Mudaliar realized the importance of education and institutioning for the women and the weaker sections of society, at a time when their welfare was never considered significant.

He formed a charitable trust with family members and appointed a Brahmin and some government officials on the board so that it could be managed without “bias”. Now his great grandson Sri. A. A. Sanjeev Narrain as Secretary and Sri. A. M. Sashindar Narrain as Treasurer is looking after the trust. RBANM’s Educational Charities has many institutions under its banner from primary to post graduation level, because of the selfless and dedicated services rendered by successive presidents, secretaries and trust board members. The high institution was the first institution under the RBANM’s banner and is about 148 years old. We are all proud to be the members of this huge family called RBANM’s “the grand old institution”.
To impart quality education to students to excel in life while striving towards the fulfilment of the dream of our founder.
Centre of academic excellence fostering the constitutional objectives of equality, justice and equity.

RBANM’s Institutions are managed by the “RBANM’s Educational Charities”, founded by Dharmarathnakara Rai Bahadur Arcot Narrainswamy Mudaliar. They are generally identified as Trust /charities. Apart from meeting the academic requirements of teaching and learning, the RBANM’s Educational Charities focuses on holistic training of the students to deal with various demands of the society. The educational system includes a pattern of training that cultivates the basic values of tolerance, humanity, consistency and pursuit towards excellence in every student. RBANM’s Educational Charities which also has a few other institutions of education at the school and collegiate level under its care.

As the principal of this institution I feel honored and privileged to have an association with dedicated staff and grand old institution RBANMS serving the society in the field of education since 1873. Ours is the institution imparting education to the needy and neglected section of the society at an affordable cost.

Our PU College follow the rules of Pre Univercity education board, Karnataka state and we have highly qualified, experienced, dedicated and students caring faculty, and the management ever ready to provide all help for alround development of the students.

Our PU College is located in prime central part of Bangalore with a very big play ground, fabulous building, magnificent infrastructure, lush green atmosphere, and ever caring teaching staff. I am proud to say that students of 5 to 6 generation studied in this institution are in very high positions in all fields all around the globe serving the society.
I welcome parents and students to associate with us for your bright, competent and meaningful future
Teaching is conducted in English

                                 Saturday - 9.30 am to 1.00 pm

He did not have the opportunity to study English language, so he studied and acquired a deep knowledge of ancient sacred Tamil literature which helped in moulding his character.

Soon after his marriage when he shifted to Bengaluru, he started vegetable and salt business. His hard work and perseverance paid off and later he started a furniture shop in the year 1852. Although he led a simple life he was known as a charitable man who always helped the poor. The Delhi Assembly of royals recognized his service to the poor and honored him with a title “Rai Bahadur”.

Sri Narrainsawmy Mudaliar expanded his business and took up construction contracts. He bagged a partnership contract for the construction of Attarakacheri (eighteen offices). He also realized the importance of education for girls in those days and started a girl’s institution in 1886 in Ulsoor, named after his wife Smt. Govindammal. He also started a technical institution with surveying, drawing, and other commercial subjects which faded away after engineering colleges came into existence in 1923.

His furniture shop flourished around the same time and earned the honor of Maharaja Sri Chamarajendra Wodeyar’s visit in 1892 and since then the shop was known to people as “Mysore Maharaja Hall”. Narrainsawmy Mudaliar realized the importance of education and institutioning for the women and the weaker sections of society, at a time when their welfare was never considered significant.

Sanjeev Narrain as Secretary and Sri. A. M. Sashindar Narrain as Treasurer is looking after the trust. Our PU College follow the rules of Pre Univercity education board, Karnataka state and we have highly qualified, experienced, dedicated and students caring faculty, and the management ever ready to provide all help for alround development of the students.

Our PU College is located in prime central part of Bangalore with a very big play ground, fabulous building, magnificent infrastructure, lush green atmosphere, and ever caring teaching staff. GENERAL GUIDELINES FOR STUDENTS
Every student is issued an identity card by the college immediately after admissions which he/she is expected to carry while in college at all times.
Entry to the college shall in no circumstances be allowed without the identity card. Loss of identity card has to be intimated to the college.
It is expected that the students do not indulge in boisterous behaviour in the class rooms and corridors. They are required to maintain perfect silence in the areas marked as “SILENCE ZONE”.
RBANM’s Pre-University College following “Zero Tolerance Policy” towards ragging according to Pre University Board norms.
Sexual Harassment cell has been set up to maintain and create an academic and work environment free of sexual harassment for students, teaching and non-teaching staff.
Smoking in the college premises is strictly prohibited.
The students are required to switch off their mobile phones in classrooms, laboratories, library and corridors.
Students are allowed to park the two-wheelers at specific area marked for student’s vehicles.
Students should read the Notice Boards regularly for information regarding schedule of classes, examinations, holidays, activities, fellowships, scholarships and other information to students.
Students should inform the office immediately, in writing under signature of the parent/guardian, in case of change in residential address and phone numbers.
No candidate shall be eligible to appear the Pre University Board examinations unless he/she fulfils the minimum attendance requirements.

Eligibility

Applicants must have a pass in Karnataka SSLC examination/Board or any other equivalent examination recognized by the Department of Pre-University Education, Karnataka.
For the complete list of guidelines, please visit the website of Department of Pre-University Education, Karnataka.
Admission Procedure

The admission process starts soon after the SSLC results.
Applications are sold in the office.
There is no facility for registration before hand nor their agents to procure admission.
You can collect the admission guide from the college office and follow the instructions.
Selection Procedure

The selection of the candidates is based on their aggregate marks scored in the qualifying exams.
The list of names of candidates provisionally selected will be displayed on the notice board on specified dates as per PU Board directives.
Selected candidates will appear for an interview along with their parents (compulsory) on the dates specified with the necessary documents.

paragraphs:
RBANM's associated with KIOC, the finest cricket academy in Bangalore offers cricket training at affordable cost to the students of RBANM throughout the year. KIOC offers bowling coaching, batting coaching, one on one coaching & more.
                  Having a team of 40+ coaches and facilities which include cutting-edge technologies, analysis software for cricket coaching, KIOC also provides accommodation for out station trainees.

RBANM's associated with South United FC Founded in 2012, they are Bengaluru’s first privately owned professional football club. They have played in the BDFA Super Division since our inception, also having earned our stripes in the Gadhinglaj United Cup, Puttaiah Memorial Cup, and the I-League Second Division.
The club naturally attracted the attention of those who consisted of the footballing hotspots of the city and they made up a large part of the team in the early days of the club.

They have always been a young team, who have afforded young players the opportunities to shine. This has meant a great effort at grassroots level to identify and hone talent. The club has dedicated itself to this journey and carving the pathways for youth to climb the ladder into professional sports.
